# Deploy Center

> Free, open-source (MIT) Mac app, Mac widgets and bash CLI that turns off Git auto-deploy on Vercel, Render and other hosts, so you stop paying for a build on every push. It shows the commits and pull requests waiting to go live and the build costs, and deploys what changed when you decide. Made for AI coding: the agent pushes as often as it likes, you deploy once; Autofix hands a failed build to a Claude Code routine that opens a fix PR; Claude in the app explains failures, writes release notes and checks if a change is safe to ship; Claude Desktop and Claude Code connect through an MCP server and a Claude Code plugin.

- Version: 0.9.1 (macOS app and `deploys` CLI).
- Hosts: Vercel and Render on by default; Netlify, Cloudflare Pages, AWS Amplify, DigitalOcean App Platform, Coolify and any deploy hook opt-in. Sources: GitHub and GitLab.
- Safe deploys: only when CI is green, a site check with automatic rollback, deploy windows, a risk score, and a guard that turns auto-deploy off again every 30 minutes.
- Savings: a simulator before you switch and a ledger afterwards, all marked as estimates.
- Everywhere: window, menu bar, Dock badge, Mac widgets, command palette (Cmd-K); an iPhone and iPad app with Face ID is on its way to the App Store.
- Teams: a shared deploy-center.json per repo, observer mode, and an optional two-person rule, without a server.
- Integrations: VS Code/Cursor/Windsurf extension, Raycast, GitHub Action, badges, daily summary to Slack/Discord/Telegram/ntfy, status page, pre-push hook, Docker image.
- Requirements: macOS 15 or later (app, universal); the `deploys` CLI is bash and installs on macOS, Linux, WSL and CI (`curl -fsSL https://deploycenter.app/install.sh | sh`).
- Privacy: no account, no telemetry, no server of its own. Your own logins and keys in the macOS keychain. Claude features are opt-in, use your own Anthropic key and send only masked text.
- Not affiliated with Vercel, Render, Netlify, Cloudflare, AWS, DigitalOcean, Coolify, GitHub, GitLab or Anthropic. Claude is a trademark of Anthropic.
- Topics: disable Vercel auto-deploy, Render auto-deploy off, Vercel Ignored Build Step, Vercel build cost, Claude Code Vercel, Claude Code deploy, Claude Code Vercel build cost, AI agent Vercel builds, fix failed Vercel build, auto fix build errors with AI.

## Guides

- [All guides](https://deploycenter.app/guides/)
- [Disable Vercel auto-deploy](https://deploycenter.app/guides/disable-vercel-auto-deploy/): Three ways to stop Vercel deploying on every push, and how to undo each.
- [Stop Vercel building every push](https://deploycenter.app/guides/stop-vercel-building-every-push/): Build less without turning Git off: previews, bots, monorepos, batching.
- [Vercel Ignored Build Step](https://deploycenter.app/guides/vercel-ignored-build-step/): Script examples for the ignore command, and the pitfalls that make it build anyway.
- [Turn off Render auto-deploy](https://deploycenter.app/guides/render-auto-deploy-off/): Dashboard, render.yaml autoDeployTrigger: off, and the Render API.
- [Stop Netlify builds](https://deploycenter.app/guides/netlify-stop-builds/): stop_builds versus an ignore command that only lets build hooks through.
- [Reduce Vercel costs](https://deploycenter.app/guides/reduce-vercel-costs/): A checklist: builds first, then functions, images and bandwidth.
- [Auto-fix failed builds with Claude](https://deploycenter.app/guides/auto-fix-failed-vercel-builds-with-claude/): A failed Vercel or Render build goes to a Claude Code routine, which opens a fix PR.

## Tools and reading

- [Deploy Center + Claude Code](https://deploycenter.app/claude-code/): Let the agent push, you decide what ships.
- [Build cost calculator](https://deploycenter.app/vercel-build-cost-calculator/): What auto-deploy costs a month, and what deploying by hand would cost.
- [AI coding agents and your build bill](https://deploycenter.app/blog/ai-coding-agents-build-bill/): Your agent pushes 40 times. You deploy once.
